'''Ingor Watt''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Shady Deal" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he planned to sell a shipment of stolen [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] on<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Charros system/Legends|Charros system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two warring powers sent a companion to make a better offer for the stolen blasters. Watt sold them the blasters and gave them something extra for the companion's trouble.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ingor Watt was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Shady Deal" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
